instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: Wait, it ends here? Have you ever shouted that when a manga ends at an exciting moment? It says the story will continue next time. What will that character say next? What will happen to the two of them? It may be a shame to keep those ideas only in your head. The company that runs LINE Manga has announced a new service. It is called ByUs, an AI chat service for stories. It is pronounced ByUs. You can talk with characters you love. You can also make your own stories based on their works. You can leave the reader's seat and step onto the stage of making stories. If you thought, can't you already talk with characters? you noticed something important. LINE Manga already has a service called Character Chat. The company says ByUs lets you do more than chat. You can also make stories more freely. So you can ask not only what should we talk about next, but also what should happen next.
